prompt: Create a high-fidelity UI concept board for AniRec, an anime recommendation web app, using the attached real PySide screenshots as visual authority. Output a landscape 2-by-2 board of FOUR actual desktop app viewports: top-left MY LIBRARY, top-right PROFILE, bottom-left COMPARE, bottom-right SETTINGS. Each viewport should have its own compact indexed left navigation rail and enough usable content to judge its layout. No perspective, no device frames, no marketing poster, no floating decoration. Highest practical resolution, legible large-enough text. References contribute green-black surfaces, bone text, brass personal signals, aqua secondary/community signals, compact monospaced headings and readable prose, thin borders and square panels. Preserve these precisely, but do NOT copy the original page geometry. Background #070C09, panels #0C1410, text #C6D4C2, brass #D9A441, aqua #5FBFB5. Keep clear rectangular focus/selection treatments and quiet surfaces without neon glow. Every viewport must visibly say SAMPLE DATA / LAYOUT CONCEPT. Shared rail: ANIREC, 01 Discover, 02 My Library, 03 Profile, 04 Compare, 05 Settings; highlight the correct tab. No invented capability claims, no recommendations advertised as watched history. Use initials poster placeholders as the real reference does, not fake anime artwork. Specific content: Library is saved recommendation decisions, Watch later and Not interested; show 3 illustrative saved titles Monster, Death Note, Steins;Gate, explicitly a sample layout. Profile is anirec_sample, completed 312, mean score 7.42; taste overlap 72%, rating bias -0.43, contrarian 31%; evidence Kotoura-san YOU 9 / COMMUNITY 6.7, Gakkougurashi! YOU 9 / COMMUNITY 7.4. Compare is anirec_sample with NeoBalls_, overlap 78%, shared 96, both rated 74; ratings Evangelion YOU 9 / FRIEND 3, One Piece YOU 4 / FRIEND 9, Spirited Away YOU 10 / FRIEND 6. Settings has Recommendation, Appearance, Account and Local data; adventurousness familiar-to-surprising, batch size 10, default sort Personal match, show covers, account not connected. Do not show authentication tokens or fake successful sync. Prioritize the structure described next over the reference layout. DIRECTION A: COMPARISON MATRIX. Make alignment the dominant structural move. Library is a roomy ruled ledger with title, Personal match, MAL score and saved action columns, one selected row and a short explanatory footer. Use Monster 94.6% / 8.87, Death Note 92.4% / 8.62, Steins;Gate 90.8% / 9.07. Profile has a compact identity strip, one horizontal band of three metrics, then a large evidence table with title, your score, community score and difference. Compare has the 78% summary above an aligned score table with diverging horizontal lines, all differences labeled numerically, short title rows and subtle initials. Settings is a disciplined full-width grouped form ledger with labels, controls and help text aligned into consistent columns. This should feel like a precision instrument for understanding taste, not four copies of a generic dashboard. Keep the matrix broad and legible with generous row height and calm blank space.
